verdict.rationale: Datadog includes an AI assistant (Bits AI), so letting users connect external MCP servers to it is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Datadog's own MCP server [datadog-docs-3, datadog-probe-3]. That is the server role, letting outside agents call Datadog's tools, not the client role this story asks about. Nothing in the pack shows Bits AI or any other part of Datadog connecting to user-supplied MCP servers.
